changelog: `apm install` of a `skills/` bundle, including `--frozen` replays, prints one skill integration line instead of two (#4217)

ledger_row.summary: A skills/ bundle install reported the same promoted skill twice, as 'Skill integrated' and '1 skill(s) integrated', on install and install --frozen.

red: APM_BINARY_PATH="$(uv run which apm)" uv run --extra dev pytest tests/integration/test_install_summary_destinations_lifecycle.py::test_skill_bundle_install_prints_one_skill_line -n 0 -p no:cacheprovider -q -> AssertionError: At index 0 diff: '  |-- Skill integrated -> .claude/skills/' != '  |-- 1 skill(s) integrated -> .claude/skills/'; Left contains one more item
notes: The services.py and skill_support.py hunks are byte-identical to the matching hunks in open PR #4143 (its #4089 fix), so the two merge without conflict. Test helpers make_skill_result in tests/integration/test_install_services_{orchestration,phase3w5}.py now model a created root skill with a skill_path (they previously passed skill_path=None, the bundle shape). services.py LOC budget is restored by the #4211 commit.
